observed_skills.name: Spelling log
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes down words they misspelt, practises them, ticks them off when learnt, and checks a dictionary or screen when unsure.

observed_skills.name: Word list and thesaurus
observed_skills.milestone: The child keeps a list of interesting words and uses it, or a dictionary or thesaurus, to choose stronger words in a later piece of writing.

observed_skills.kind: range of reading over a term
observed_skills.name: Reading stories, poems and plays
observed_skills.milestone: Over the term the child reads stories, poems and playscripts and can say what a picture or screen image adds to one of them.

observed_skills.kind: range of reading over a term
observed_skills.name: Reading non-fiction
observed_skills.milestone: The child reads instructions, a report and a recount during the term and can say what each one is for.

observed_skills.name: Reading for enjoyment
observed_skills.milestone: The child chooses books freely, stays with them, reads alone and with others, and wants to share what they have read.

observed_skills.name: Silent reading
observed_skills.milestone: The child reads quietly to themselves without saying the words aloud or pointing, keeps their place and can answer a question about the page.

observed_skills.name: Stories and poems
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes a complete story and a poem, each with ideas that hold together from the start to the end.

observed_skills.name: Writing a text with its features
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes a whole information page and a set of instructions, each with the features that kind of text needs.

observed_skills.name: Writing for a named reader
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes an advert or invitation for a named reader, choosing content and words that reader will understand and enjoy.

observed_skills.name: Joined-up handwriting
observed_skills.milestone: The child forms, sizes and joins letters steadily, so a page of their exercise book is easy to read.

observed_skills.name: Laying out a page
observed_skills.milestone: The child lays out a page by hand, in print or on screen to suit its reader and purpose, and explains the choice.

observed_skills.name: Speaking with confidence
observed_skills.milestone: The child talks about familiar things in a steady voice, without long stops, and seems at ease.

observed_skills.name: Choosing what to say
observed_skills.milestone: When telling someone something, the child picks the facts that matter, with enough detail and nothing that does not belong.

observed_skills.name: Words that suit the moment
observed_skills.milestone: The child uses friendly words with a friend and more careful words when talking to the class or a visitor.

observed_skills.name: Face and hands when speaking
observed_skills.milestone: The child looks at the listeners and uses gestures and facial expressions that match what they are saying.

observed_skills.name: Talking to an audience
observed_skills.milestone: The child changes how they speak, such as their tone and word choice, to keep a particular group of listeners interested.

observed_skills.name: Following spoken instructions
observed_skills.milestone: The child listens to a few instructions and then does each step in the right order.

observed_skills.name: Asking about what was heard
observed_skills.milestone: After a story or talk, the child asks a question that shows they understood its main points.

observed_skills.name: Taking a role in a group
observed_skills.milestone: The child is given a job in a group, such as reader or timekeeper, and keeps to it.

observed_skills.name: Disagreeing politely
observed_skills.milestone: The child answers someone else's view kindly and then gives their own view.

observed_skills.name: Adding to a discussion
observed_skills.milestone: The child makes comments that stay on the topic and help the talk move forward.

observed_skills.name: Taking turns to talk
observed_skills.milestone: The child waits for their turn, listens to others and mentions what someone said before adding their own idea.

observed_skills.name: Reading aloud with expression
observed_skills.milestone: The child reads a short passage aloud so that their voice rises, falls and slows to fit what the words mean.

observed_skills.name: Voices for characters
observed_skills.milestone: When reading a story with talking aloud, the child gives each character a different voice.

observed_skills.name: Reading aloud accurately
observed_skills.milestone: The child reads a familiar page aloud with few wrong words and pauses at full stops and commas.

observed_skills.name: Acting a character
observed_skills.milestone: The child uses voice, gestures and movement to play a character in a drama so the audience can tell who it is.

observed_skills.name: Giving a short talk
observed_skills.milestone: The child plans a talk on a familiar subject beforehand and gives it alone, in a sensible order.

observed_skills.name: Talking about talks
observed_skills.milestone: After a talk or presentation, the child names one thing that went well and one thing to do better next time.

observed_skills.name: How meaning is shown
observed_skills.milestone: The child can say how a speaker's words, face and hands together showed what they meant or felt.

observed_skills.name: Spelling log
observed_skills.milestone: The child keeps a log of words they got wrong in their own writing, learns them, checks them in a dictionary or on screen, and ticks them off.

observed_skills.name: Word list and thesaurus
observed_skills.milestone: Compared with a month ago, the child uses words from their own list, a dictionary or a thesaurus to make their writing richer.

observed_skills.kind: range of reading over a term
observed_skills.name: Reading stories, poems and plays
observed_skills.milestone: During the term the child reads a chapter of a longer story, a poem and a playscript, and says what a picture or screen image added.

observed_skills.kind: range of reading over a term
observed_skills.name: Reading non-fiction
observed_skills.milestone: The child reads a report, an advert, a recipe and a news article this term and can say what makes each one different.

observed_skills.name: Reading for enjoyment
observed_skills.milestone: The child picks books freely, finishes them, reads alone and with others, and likes to share them.

observed_skills.name: Favourite books
observed_skills.milestone: The child has favourite books and recommends one to a friend, giving a reason why the friend would like it.

observed_skills.name: Stories and poems
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes complete stories and different kinds of poems, with ideas that hold together from the start to the end.

observed_skills.name: Writing a text with its features
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes a whole information page and an advert, each with the features that kind of text needs.

observed_skills.name: Writing for a named reader
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes a letter or advert for a named reader, choosing content and words that make that reader understand and agree.

observed_skills.name: Neat, quicker handwriting
observed_skills.milestone: The child writes clearly with joined letters and can copy a passage in three minutes without the writing becoming untidy.

observed_skills.name: Laying out a page on screen
observed_skills.milestone: The child lays out a page with headings and pictures on screen, by hand or in print to suit the reader, and says why.

observed_skills.name: Speaking at length
observed_skills.milestone: The child talks about a familiar topic for a minute or more with few slips in grammar or word choice.

observed_skills.name: Putting ideas in order
observed_skills.milestone: When explaining something, the child puts the information in an order that helps the listener follow.

observed_skills.name: Exact words
observed_skills.milestone: The child chooses precise words, such as sprinted or fragile, instead of general ones when explaining.

observed_skills.name: Face and hands when speaking
observed_skills.milestone: The child looks at the listeners and uses gestures and expressions that fit what they are saying, for different reasons.

observed_skills.name: Talking to an audience
observed_skills.milestone: The child changes their language and tone to suit a younger class or a visitor and keeps that audience interested.

observed_skills.name: Listening and asking questions
observed_skills.milestone: After listening to a classmate, the child asks and answers questions that build on the ideas they heard.

observed_skills.name: Taking a role in a group
observed_skills.milestone: The child takes a job in a group and keeps to it until the task is finished.

observed_skills.name: Disagreeing politely with a reason
observed_skills.milestone: The child answers another view kindly, gives their own view and says why.

observed_skills.name: Adding comments and questions
observed_skills.milestone: The child adds comments and questions that stay on the topic and bring something new to the talk.

observed_skills.name: Linking to what others said
observed_skills.milestone: The child takes turns and connects what they say to the speaker before them.

observed_skills.name: Pace and volume when reading aloud
observed_skills.milestone: The child reads a lively passage aloud, speeding up, slowing down, and getting louder or softer to fit the content.

observed_skills.name: Reading aloud smoothly
observed_skills.milestone: The child reads a page aloud with few wrong words and a smooth flow, pausing at commas and full stops.

observed_skills.name: Changing character in drama
observed_skills.milestone: The child plays a character with voice, gesture and movement, and can change them to play a different character.

observed_skills.name: Group presentation
observed_skills.milestone: The child helps plan a group presentation on a familiar subject and speaks well in it, even in front of a wider audience.

observed_skills.name: Strengths and next steps
observed_skills.milestone: After a talk, the child names one strength in their own or a friend's talk and one change for next time.

observed_skills.name: How words and body show meaning
observed_skills.milestone: The child can explain how a speaker's face and hands changed what the words meant.
